x: The APPSC key: neither is correct. Books treat Andrott as the largest of the Lakshadweep islands (Kavaratti is the capital), and the Eight Degree Channel — not the Nine — separates Minicoy from the Maldives.
dispute: APPSC key and most books: neither (Andrott largest). Strictly Kavaratti is the largest town by Census 2011 population (11,210 vs Andrott 11,191), so 'Statement I only' is arguable; Andrott is the largest island by area.
